Class SysMLIcon

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.occurrences.SysMLOccurrence
sysmlinjava.items.SysMLItem
sysmlinjava.metadata.SysMLMetadata
sysmlinjava.metadata.SysMLIcon
public final class SysMLIcon extends SysMLMetadata
SysMLinJava's representation of the SysML icon metadata. SysMLIcon is a specialized type of SysMLMetadata used to annotate a model element with an image to be used to render the element on a diagram and/or a small image to be used as an adornment on a graphical or textual rendering.
